title: Where to measure from
text: The $$\theta=0$$ location is measured from the positive horizontal axis.

title: Find the location
text: Thus the location $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}=-2\pi+\frac{-\pi}{3}$$ radians is on the lower half of the circle.

title: Measure from $$-2\pi$$
text: Measure $$-\pi/3$$ radians from $$-2\pi$$ radians, which is also the same point as $$0$$ radians.

title: Measure from $$-2\pi$$
text: It is the point in the 4th quadrant that is one third of the way along the lower half circle.
